course.name: Custom Nodes
course.description: Build and test one TypeScript WASM node in a saved board.
course.longDescription: 35 minutes required. Prerequisites: basic TypeScript, a maintained TypeScript node template, Node/npm or mise and Desktop Developer Mode. Supplied source and tests implement a small text normalizer. Local loading is sufficient for the core course; the 7-minute publication class is optional. Build and runtime checks remain separate.

modules.title: Build and check
modules.description: Complete the practical steps and inspect the result.

challenges.prompt: A saved board already wires the result output. Which change requires compatibility planning?

options.label: Renaming the internal result pin.
Rewording a friendly label while keeping its internal identifier.
Adding a test case.

lessons.title: Read the contract and return behavior

challenges.prompt: What does the current TypeScript SDK’s ctx.success() do for the default execution path?
challenges.explanation: It activates exec_out and returns the accumulated result.

options.label: It always returns no activated pins.
It discovers node definitions in the manifest.
It activates exec_out and returns the accumulated result.

lessons.title: Build and load the package locally

challenges.prompt: Unit tests pass but build/node.wasm predates your change. What should you load?
challenges.explanation: Build the current source successfully and load that resulting artifact.

options.label: The TypeScript test file as a WASM module.
Build the current source successfully and load that resulting artifact.
The old artifact, because unit tests update it automatically.

lessons.title: Test behavior, persistence and the host

challenges.prompt: A fresh board runs the new package. What compatibility check is still needed?
challenges.explanation: Open and run a board saved with the previous package contract.

options.label: Open and run a board saved with the previous package contract.
Rename all pin IDs to match the new labels.
Delete old boards to avoid compatibility questions.

challenges.prompt: A bug is fixed after 0.1.0 was published. What release action preserves immutable artifact identity?

Keep the same version but rename the file.

modules.title: Apply it
modules.description: Use the result to solve a new case.

challenges.prompt: A teammate renames result to output and updates every unit test. What evidence could still expose a break?
challenges.explanation: A consumer board saved before the rename.

options.label: A prettier package description.

challenges.prompt: A new HTTP call passes through MockHostBridge but fails in the runtime. What should you inspect?
challenges.explanation: The node capability declaration, host configuration and actual runtime error.

options.label: The node capability declaration, host configuration and actual runtime error.

challenges.prompt: The code intentionally selects a custom execution branch. What should the test assert?
challenges.explanation: The returned activated pin set, alongside output values.

options.label: Only that the function returns an object.

The returned activated pin set, alongside output values.
